seo.title: Privacy policy
seo.description: How arafatbin.com collects, uses and protects your personal data.

hero.title: Privacy policy
hero.text: What data this website collects and how it is used.

sections.heading: 1. Data I collect
paragraphs: When you use the contact or review form I receive the details you type in, such as your name, email and message.

sections.heading: 2. Analytics
paragraphs: This website uses Google Analytics to understand how visitors use it. Google Analytics uses cookies and collects anonymous usage data.

sections.heading: 3. How I use your data
list: To reply to your message or order
To deliver services and products you ordered
To show your review, only if you allow it

sections.heading: 4. Third-party services
paragraphs: Forms are delivered by Web3Forms. Links to WhatsApp, LinkedIn and Fiverr follow those services' own privacy policies.

sections.heading: 5. Data sharing
paragraphs: I do not sell or rent your personal data to anyone.

sections.heading: 6. Your rights
paragraphs: You can ask me to show, correct or delete the data I hold about you by emailing contact@arafatbin.com.

sections.heading: 7. Changes
paragraphs: This policy may be updated. The date at the top shows the latest version.
